name: Stella
source:
Stella's been stepped on her entire existence. In work, in love, in everything. She'd just never really realised it till now. Everyone uses her to get to where they need to be, but where they need to be is rarely with Stella. After settling for silent gratitude most of her life, Stella's stepping out on her own terms, recently aligning herself with Airway as an affiliate ambassador. Determined to take back control, Stella's stepping up to the plate to control her own finances, even if she's a little wobbly on her feet.
Likes: Structure 
Dislikes: Feeling Left Out

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
